title: Garage
dek: Detailing gear, battery maintainers and storage for keeping a German car, a Porsche especially, sharp in the garage.

boards.title: Paint care
boards.dek: Griot's polishers, foam and towels, sold by the Porsche parts specialist FCP Euro.

boards.title: Battery maintainers
boards.dek: CTEK chargers for a car that sits through winter.

boards.title: Garage storage
boards.dek: Wall, ceiling and cabinet storage from Bob Vila's tested roundup.

items.name: G9 Random Orbital Polisher (10901)
items.why: A 9 mm-throw dual-action polisher with constant-speed electronics, the best-overall pick in Power Tool Insider's October 2026 polisher roundup. Pads and backing plate are sold separately, and a 12 mm-throw machine corrects heavy defects faster.

items.name: G8 Mini Random Orbital Polisher (10908)
items.why: Griot's smaller random orbital polisher, for areas too tight for the G9. FCP Euro, a Porsche and BMW parts specialist, stocks it next to the G9.

items.name: THE BOSS Foam Cannon (BF302)
items.why: A stainless-steel foam cannon that screws straight onto the soap bottle and uses metering tips to set the dilution. Buyers on Detailed Image praise the build but call it pricey, and say it foams best with Griot's own soaps.

items.name: Extra-Large PFM Edgeless Drying Towel (55596)
items.why: An extra-large edgeless microfiber drying towel, with no stitched edge to drag across the paint.

items.name: Ceramic Detailing Kit (CERAMICKT)
items.why: A kit for cleaning and maintaining a car that already has a ceramic coating.

items.name: NXT 5 Battery Charger, 12V (40-658)
items.why: CTEK's successor to the MXS 5.0: it also charges lithium batteries, reads battery condition better and has an improved reconditioning mode, and it keeps the connect-and-forget maintenance mode. The Scotsman's review calls it a worthy successor and says it is mainly worth the extra cost for lithium batteries.

items.name: MXS 5.0 Test & Charge Battery Charger (40-206)
items.why: A long-running CTEK maintainer that keeps a stored car's battery topped up. The Scotsman's reviewer says it is still the practical pick unless the car has a lithium battery. FCP Euro lists it for the 718 and other Porsches.

items.name: MXS 5.0 with Ammo NYC Chargeguard (AMO40-206)
items.why: The same MXS 5.0 sold as a bundle with an Ammo NYC Chargeguard. FCP Euro lists the bundle among its Porsche battery maintainers.

items.name: Metal Pegboard Standard Tool Storage Kit
items.why: Powder-coated steel pegboard panels with hooks, the best pegboard in Bob Vila's tested storage roundup. Garage Gym Lab's long-term review rates it 9.4/10 and says to mount heavy loads on studs, not drywall anchors.

items.name: Classic 4x8 Overhead Garage Storage Rack
items.why: A ceiling rack in heavy-duty steel rated to 600 lb, for seasonal or rarely used things. Bob Vila's tester named it best overhead and notes that it takes two people to install.

items.name: 3-Piece Regular-Duty Welded Steel Garage Storage System
items.why: Welded steel cabinets with soft-close doors and a 500 lb capacity. Bob Vila tested it in a garage and named it best overall.
items.ebay: husky 3 piece welded steel garage storage
